handover_protocol.rule: Live GitHub state outranks this snapshot. Fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, CI/deployments and concurrent branches before mutation.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Legal Corpus First

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable rights/source qualification, provenance/attribution classification, bounded measurement, protected prewrite, implementation, ordinary CI/deployment and source-audit work. Stop only for a genuine human/security/cost/source-rights/topology/unrecoverable blocker, an owner-authenticated production-write gate, or continuation boundary.
operating_contract.rights: Fail closed. Private runtime creates no reuse permission. Unknown or materially unresolved rights are held or rejected. Every admitted cohort must carry provenance and attribution/disclosure classification.
operating_contract.storage: Protected recipe bodies remain in private Cloudflare D1. GitHub contains only public code and public-safe evidence/artifacts. Browser-direct protected database access is forbidden.
operating_contract.authentication: Every protected request remains server-side authenticated and authorized through the application-owned identity verifier, exact allowlist and secure session. Do not weaken or emulate the owner authentication gate.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure, billing enablement or automatic overage authorization.
operating_contract.topology: Exactly two protected recipe-body D1 shards. No third shard is authorized.
operating_contract.d1_budget: Fresh route-write design ceiling remains 16/16 D1 subqueries with zero assumed headroom. The v8007 observed maximum of 8 does not widen this contract.
operating_contract.public_activation: Public runtime remains 85 recipes and broader public corpus/recommendation activation is not authorized.
operating_contract.source_authority: Historical provenance is not authority for cultural authenticity, nutrition, allergens, dietary classification, scaling or medical claims.

next_iteration.rule: Do not prewrite, implement or populate this collection until each admitted source cohort independently clears rights/provenance, attribution classification and bounded marginal-value/capacity measurement. Split, hold or reject records when source-level evidence differs.

not_authorized: No paid infrastructure or billing/automatic overage authorization.
No broader public recipe corpus activation.
No Nutrition lane mutation before its roadmap turn.
No YT-CUL optimization before its roadmap turn.
No Knowledge Core mutation from the app lane unless separately authorized.
No automatic inference of cultural authenticity, nutrition, allergen, dietary or scaling authority from historical source provenance.
stop_conditions: An owner-authenticated production-write gate is reached.
Paid infrastructure or billing would be required.
Two-shard topology proves insufficient and a third shard would be required.
A required protected request cannot remain within the existing D1 limits.
Marginal source value becomes too low.
A genuine unrecoverable technical error occurs.
